no_set_verb_finding: No verb can set holds on an existing row arbitrarily (writers: add bundle/--holds, suggest empty, holds --sync bundle-sourced). A row whose bundle declares no holds= can never acquire holds after registration. Smallest honest fix: `holds <id> --set a,b,c` mirroring `needs <id> --add`. holds --sync was the backfill path used here.
